intervention_names: Drug: Triple Therapy of Other Oral Antidiabetic Drugs
arm_groups.label: Triple Therapy of Other Oral Antidiabetic Drugs

brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety of the triple combination therapy of Met/SGLT-2i/GLP-1RA or other oral antidiabetic drugs in patients with type 2 diabetes exhibiting poor glycemic control.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of the Met+SGLT-2i+GLP-1RA in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes With Poor Glycemic Control

interventions.name: Triple Therapy of Other Oral Antidiabetic Drugs

lead_sponsor.name: Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

official_title: Efficacy and Safety of the Triple Combination Therapy of Met/SGLT-2i/GLP-1RA or Other Oral Antidiabetic Drugs in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Exhibiting Poor Glycemic Control

primary_outcomes.measure: The change of HbA1c compared to the baseline
